en: A black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a busy market square filled with people, stalls, and horse‑drawn carts. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings, including a church-like structure with a steep roof on the left and a tall towered building on the right. The caption at the top in red print reads "Komotau. Marktplatz." indicating the main marketplace of the town.
